# Console variables and commands

Open the Console panel and type a name to read it, `name value` to set it, `name default` to restore it. Values set here override the scene / project settings at runtime. `Config/ConsoleVariables.ini` in the project is applied on load (one `name value` per line). Scripts use `CVarGet` / `CVarSet` / `ConsoleCommand`.

## AI (`ai.*`)

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ai.ShowNavMesh` | `0` | Draw the baked navigation mesh |

## Audio (`au.*`)

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `au.MasterVolume` | `1` | Master audio volume (0..1+) |

## Input (`input.*`)

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `input.GlyphStyle` | `auto` | Button glyph style: auto, keyboard, xbox, playstation, nintendo, deck |

## Physics (`p.*`)

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `p.GravityY` | `-9.81` | Vertical gravity in m/s^2 (3D physics) |

## Rendering (`r.*`)

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `r.AntiAliasing` | `1` | Anti-aliasing method: 0 off, 1 FXAA, 2 SMAA, 3 TAA, 4 TAA+FXAA, 5 MSAA, 6 CSAA, 7 SSAA, 8 FSAA, 9 EQAA, 10 MLAA, 11 CMAA, 12 TXAA, 13 TSAA, 15 SMAA T2x, 16 TSRAA, 19 DLAA, 26 FSR AA, 27 XeSS AA, 28 OGSSAA, 29 SGSSAA, 30 RGSS, 31 TSSAA, 32 DEAA, 33 GBAA, 34 SRAA (a method this system cannot run falls back to the closest one; old upscaler numbers 14, 17, 18, 20-25 map to TAA + r.Upscaler) |
| `r.AutoExposure` | `0` | Eye adaptation (auto exposure) on/off |
| `r.Bloom` | `1` | Bloom on/off |
| `r.Bloom.Intensity` | `0.6` | Bloom intensity |
| `r.ChromaticAberration` | `0` | Chromatic aberration on/off |
| `r.ColorGrading` | `1` | Color grading on/off |
| `r.Contrast` | `1` | Color grading contrast |
| `r.DepthOfField` | `0` | Depth of field on/off |
| `r.Exposure` | `0` | Exposure in EV |
| `r.FilmGrain` | `0` | Film grain on/off |
| `r.Fog` | `0` | Scene fog on/off |
| `r.Fog.Density` | `0.02` | Exponential fog density |
| `r.ForceLOD` | `-1` | Force a mesh LOD level on every Auto LOD mesh (-1 = automatic by screen size) |
| `r.FrustumCulling` | `1` | Skip meshes outside the camera view and outside each shadow cascade (0 = draw everything, for debugging) |
| `r.MotionBlur` | `0` | Camera motion blur on/off |
| `r.OpaqueSort` | `1` | Opaque draw order: 1 front to back, alpha-tested (cutout) after opaque (default); 0 submission order |
| `r.PostProcess` | `1` | Whole post processing stack on/off |
| `r.Quality` | `2` | Quality level: 0 Low, 1 Medium, 2 High, 3 Ultra |
| `r.Saturation` | `1` | Color grading saturation |
| `r.ScreenPercentage` | `66.6667` | Upscaler internal resolution in percent (33 .. 100); sets the quality mode to Custom |
| `r.Shadows` | `1` | Realtime shadows on/off |
| `r.Shadows.Cascades` | `2` | Directional light shadow cascades (1..4) |
| `r.Shadows.Distance` | `80` | Shadow draw distance in meters |
| `r.Shadows.Resolution` | `4096` | Shadow atlas width in pixels (512..8192) |
| `r.Sharpen` | `0` | Sharpen filter on/off |
| `r.SkyAtmosphere` | `0` | Physically based sky atmosphere on/off |
| `r.SSAO` | `1` | Screen space ambient occlusion on/off |
| `r.SSGI` | `0` | Screen space global illumination (Lumen-style screen traces) on/off |
| `r.SSGI.Intensity` | `1` | Screen space GI bounce strength |
| `r.SSR` | `0` | Screen space reflections on/off |
| `r.TAADebug` | `0` | TAA debug view: 0 off, 1 per-pixel history path (red moving, green settled, cyan calm, blue trusted, yellow clamped, magenta sky, white no history) |
| `r.TemporalStability` | `1` | Temporal stability for single-frame AA methods: 1 on (the method's result is accumulated over sub-pixel jittered frames like TAA; SMAA T2x averages only flickering pixels), 0 off |
| `r.Tonemapper` | `1` | 0 none, 1 Neutral, 2 ACES, 3 AgX, 4 Reinhard |
| `r.Upscaler` | `0` | Upscaler: 0 off (native), 1 FSR 1, 2 CAS, 3 NIS, 4 TAAU, 5 TSR, 6 DLSS, 7 XeSS, 8 MetalFX, 9 PSSR, 10 FSR 2 (an upscaler this system cannot run falls back to FSR 1) |
| `r.Vignette` | `0` | Vignette on/off |
| `r.VolumetricClouds` | `0` | Volumetric clouds on/off |
| `r.VolumetricFog` | `0` | Volumetric fog (shadowed light shafts) on/off |
| `r.VSync` | `1` | Vertical sync on/off |

## Time (`t.*`)

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `t.MaxFPS` | `0` | Frame rate limit (0 = unlimited) |
| `t.TimeScale` | `1` | Game time scale (1 = normal speed) |

## UI (`ui.*`)

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ui.OnScreenKeyboard` | `0` | On-screen keyboard for text fields: 0 auto (gamepad / Steam Deck / touch), 1 always, 2 off |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `dumpcvars` | List every console variable with its value (optional prefix) |
| `exec` | Run a file of console lines: exec Config/Low.ini |
| `help` | List console variables and commands (optional prefix): help r. |
| `r.ResetOverrides` | Return every r.* variable to the scene's own settings |
| `slomo` | Set the game time scale: slomo 0.5 |
| `stat` | Statistics overlay: stat fps \| unit \| none |
